title: Confirm review labels reach the decision prompt (evidence gap)
description: The proof used reviews as in-context priming examples (priming_proof.py:179). The live sweep sends them as review() labels (relevance_sweep.py:359-387). Confirm whether those enter the decision prompt in the external Cyclotron engine, or add the priming-examples step before each sweep.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Read the local Cyclotron source: embedded_cyclotron.py:855 review() says the first label for a decision teaches the cyclotron and a later label is a correction, through a learning pass (learning_loop.decide_with_shared_context, feedback_partitions, line 1345 set_optimizer_context). So live review labels do feed the cyclotron's learning loop. Still not confirmed: whether they end up as in-context examples in the Jev decision prompt the way the proof's priming examples do. Needs a read of learning_loop.py and the Jev adapter, or a small experiment comparing a sweep with and without added priming examples.

right_now_summary: The team confirmed review labels reach learning but must verify they enter the Jev decision prompt.
